stripe_objects.credits: Checkout sessions (one-time payments) writing invoice records into the CRM

stripe_objects.subscriptions: Stripe Billing subscriptions for active plans

money.note: Amounts are the owner's to set. null = not yet priced; nothing sells until every amount is set and the merchant account is connected.

plans.description: The practice runs the campaign: audit, rounds, letters, and the book kept for the client.
plans.name: Full Campaign

products.description: One escalation round fired across a client's failing tradelines and inquiries.
